state:
**Side goal `fmt-layout-from-breaks`, stages 2 and 3 landed except shape types.** `nvs fmt` lays out every list as one line or one item per line (`crates/nvs-fmt/src/list.rs`). It lays out a `->` / `?->` call chain as one line or one call per line, and an `&&`, `||`, `??` or `.` chain as one line or one operand per line, operator first. A broken `if` / `elseif` / `while` / `do … while` condition puts `(` and `)` on lines of their own. All three are in `crates/nvs-fmt/src/chain.rs`, wired beside `list` in `crates/nvs-fmt/src/indent.rs` and `crates/nvs-fmt/src/print.rs`. `crates/nvs-fmt/tests/chain_layout.rs` holds the stage-3 check's 9 tests plus one, and the corpus is reformatted. `rule:tooling/fmt-a-broken-call-chain-is-one-call-per-line` and `rule:tooling/fmt-a-broken-operator-chain-is-one-operand-per-line` are `shipped`.

Still not a list: a shape type (gap `comma-separated-list-whose-closing-delimiter`), so `rule:tooling/fmt-a-list-is-one-line-or-one-item-per-line` stays `designed`. Stage 4 (editor actions) is not started.
